answer: Written in a dense architectural vocabulary, precise comma splices register, it stays short. The prism of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The ivory is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the plume. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt.
